tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the aitools.obzdn.co directory of AI and open-source tools for owner-operators and small teams. Returns up to `limit` tools with what each does, who it fits, starting price, the catch to watch for, and links.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full aitools.obzdn.co listing for one tool by its id (from search_tools).

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: OBZDN's done-for-you services with starting prices, what is included and typical timelines.

tools.name: get_setup_quote
tools.description: Starting price for OBZDN to set up a specific tool (by aitools id) or deliver a service (by service id). Prices are 'from' prices; the final price is confirmed on a 20-minute call.

tools.name: request_setup
tools.description: Hand a setup job to OBZDN on behalf of the person you represent. Only call this when they asked for it AND agreed to share these contact details with OBZDN. Returns the booking link for them to pick a 20-minute call. OBZDN never asks for passwords; access is granted by the owner on the call.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "request_setup" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
